reason: The wrapper-era template did not bind the exact G4/G5 preflight receipt SHA or exact G6/G7 code SHAs and is therefore not sufficient as a future runtime authorization boundary.
instructions: Do not rename or adapt this superseded template into a runtime authorization.
Do not execute the current wrapper-based V2 materializer under this template.

A future authorization surface must be generated only from the standalone V2 design after successful G4/G5 receipt review, TDD qualification of the standalone successor, and a new explicit owner decision.
Historical V1 schema/token remain invalid for any future hardened path.
